source: prod session ecfb8c41 (2026-09-19), @IDAIRL, gemini-3.1-flash-lite — the fan-out run: turn 1 joined mileage_redemption to member_benefit on ffp_member_id (both FOREIGN keys to ffp_member) and reported 2,638,492 miles redeemed for member 2 (true: 17,708); turn 2 repeated the shape with miles_balance
notes: agent_calls are the RECORDED (wrong) SQL. `fanout_pairs` = [holder, holder, column] the enrichment must NAME as a fan-out (handed to the preflight guard as metadata.fanout_keys), never as a join hint

turns.query: Which 5 members have redeemed the most miles, and what are their tier statuses?

arguments.sql: SELECT TOP 5 R.ffp_member_id, SUM(R.miles_redeemed) AS total_redeemed, B.tier_status_id FROM airlines_core.mileage_redemption R JOIN airlines_core.member_benefit B ON R.ffp_member_id = B.ffp_member_id GROUP BY R.ffp_member_id, B.tier_status_id ORDER BY total_redeemed DESC

SELECT R.ffp_member_id, SUM(R.miles_redeemed) AS total_redeemed, MAX(B.tier_status_id) AS tier_status_id FROM airlines_core.mileage_redemption R LEFT JOIN airlines_core.member_benefit B ON R.ffp_member_id = B.ffp_member_id WHERE R.ffp_member_id IN (2, 17, 21, 29, 28) GROUP BY R.ffp_member_id ORDER BY total_redeemed DESC

turns.query: And how many miles does each of them still have in their balance?

arguments.sql: SELECT TOP 5 R.ffp_member_id, SUM(R.miles_redeemed) AS total_miles_redeemed, B.total_miles_balance FROM airlines_core.mileage_redemption R JOIN airlines_core.miles_balance B ON R.ffp_member_id = B.ffp_member_id GROUP BY R.ffp_member_id, B.total_miles_balance ORDER BY total_miles_redeemed DESC
SELECT ffp_member_id, total_miles_balance FROM airlines_core.miles_balance WHERE ffp_member_id IN (2, 17, 21, 29, 28)
